host.description: IRC server hostname to connect to (required)

bind.description: Source address to bind when connecting (e.g., 0.0.0.0 or ::)

cert.description: Path to TLS client certificate file

priv.description: Path to TLS client private key file

trust.description: Path to trusted self-signed certificate file

sasl_plain.description: SASL PLAIN authentication as user:pass (leave pass blank to prompt)

nick.description: List of preferred nicknames (tried in order); each string is a single nick or multiple space-separated nicks in one string element; default is USER env var or 'user' if set elsewhere

user_mode.description: User mode string to set on connect

join.description: Initial comma-separated channel list; optional keys can follow as space-separated (e.g., '#foo,#bar key1 key2')

highlight.description: List of case-insensitive glob patterns for message highlighting

ignore.description: List of case-insensitive glob patterns for message ignoring

timestamp.description: strftime(3) format for timestamps; empty string disables timestamps

hash.description: Nick/channel color hash seed,bound (e.g., 0,15 for 16-color set; 0,0 disables)

copy.description: Utility and arguments for /copy command (multiple entries supported)

notify.description: Utility and arguments for notifications (multiple entries supported)

open.description: Utility and arguments for /open command (multiple entries supported)

quiet.description: Raise message visibility threshold to hide general events (joins, quits, etc.)

save.description: Name or path for window state save file

debug.description: Log raw IRC messages to <debug> window and stderr (if not a terminal)
